cond_0001.intro: As a member of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of our various distilled products that meet [Company name masked]'s commercially accepted criteria.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift
Performing microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients.
Performing process audits to monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Performing inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Performing sensory analysis of in process products, finished products and ingredients
Performing analytical testing on in process products, finished products and ingredients to ensure adherence to product specifications
Outputs/Deliverables:
Development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement.
Document procedures to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Define the requirements and train Quality Technicians to perform basic troubleshooting of equipment.
Perform microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with Company defined protocols
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments.
Ability to analyze issues and provide logical resolutions
Strong communication and writing skills
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task
Preferred Requirements:
Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering, or 3-5 years of analytical experience in a laboratory or plant environment
Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management

cond_0126.intro: As part of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician works with the team to ensure that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of various distilled products that meet commercially accepted criteria.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift, working alongside shift teams
Coordinating microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients
Working with operations to perform process audits and monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Supporting inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Collaborating on sensory analysis of in-process products, finished products and ingredients
Assisting with analytical testing on in-process products, finished products and ingredients to help ensure adherence to product specifications
Coordinating the development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement
Documenting procedures together with the team to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Helping define requirements and supporting the training of Quality Technicians to perform basic troubleshooting of equipment
Performing microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with company-defined protocols, sharing results with relevant stakeholders
cond_0126.requirements:
Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering preferred or 3-5 years of analytical experience in a laboratory or in a plant environment
Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients is a plus
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology is a plus
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management is a plus
Ability to analyze issues and provide logical resolutions
Strong communication and writing skills
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task

cond_0231.intro: As a member of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of our various distilled products that meet [Company name masked]'s commercially accepted criteria. A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with production staff and quality colleagues across the shift.
cond_0231.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift
Performing microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients.
Performing process audits to monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Performing inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Performing sensory analysis of in process products, finished products and ingredients
Performing analytical testing on in process products, finished products and ingredients to ensure adherence to product specifications
Development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement.
Document procedures to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Define the requirements and actively communicate with Quality Technicians to train them in basic troubleshooting of equipment.
Perform microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with [Company name masked] defined protocols
cond_0231.requirements:
Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering preferred or 3-5 years of analytical experience in a laboratory or in a plant environment
Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients is a plus
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology is a plus.
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments.
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management is a plus.
Ability to analyze issues and communicate logical resolutions clearly to the team
Strong communication and writing skills
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task

cond_0258.intro: As a member of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of our various distilled products that meet [Company name masked]'s commercially accepted criteria.
cond_0258.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift
Performing microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients, and regularly communicating findings with the team.
Performing process audits to monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Performing inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Performing sensory analysis of in process products, finished products and ingredients
Performing analytical testing on in process products, finished products and ingredients to ensure adherence to product specifications
Outputs/Deliverables:
Development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement.
Document procedures to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Define the requirements and actively train Quality Technicians to perform basic troubleshooting of equipment, walking them through procedures and handling questions as they come up.
Perform microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with Company defined protocols
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments.
Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering, or 3-5 years of analytical experience in a laboratory or plant environment.
Ability to analyze issues and provide logical resolutions
Strong communication and writing skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings and raise issues with colleagues and supervisors.
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients.
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology.
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management.

cond_0342.intro: As part of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician works with the team to ensure that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of various distilled products that meet commercially accepted criteria.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift, working alongside shift teams
Coordinating microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients
Working with operations to perform process audits and monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Supporting inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Collaborating on sensory analysis of in-process products, finished products and ingredients
Assisting with analytical testing on in-process products, finished products and ingredients to help ensure adherence to product specifications
Coordinating the development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement
Documenting procedures together with the team to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Helping define requirements and supporting the training of Quality Technicians to perform basic troubleshooting of equipment
Performing microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with company-defined protocols, sharing results with relevant stakeholders
cond_0342.requirements:
Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering preferred or 3-5 years of analytical experience in a laboratory or in a plant environment
Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients is a plus
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology is a plus
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management is a plus
Ability to analyze issues and provide logical resolutions
Strong communication and writing skills
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task

cond_0519.intro: As a member of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of our various distilled products that meet [Company name masked]'s commercially accepted criteria. cond_0519.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift
Performing microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients.
Performing process audits to monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Performing inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Performing sensory analysis of in process products, finished products and ingredients
Performing analytical testing on in process products, finished products and ingredients to ensure adherence to product specifications
Development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement.
Document procedures to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Define the requirements and actively communicate with Quality Technicians to train them in basic troubleshooting of equipment.
Perform microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with [Company name masked] defined protocols

Familiarity with HPLC, spectrophotometer, alcolyzer and other equipment used in analysis of distilled products and ingredients is a plus
Familiarity with microbiological test methodology is a plus.
Prior experience working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments.
Familiarity with non-conforming product hold management is a plus.
Ability to analyze issues and communicate logical resolutions clearly to the team
Strong communication and writing skills
Strong organization skills
Ability to multi-task

cond_0552.intro: As a member of the plant quality team, the Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production maintains the established standards and quality control systems outlined by [Company name masked] to safely produce quality cases of our various distilled products that meet [Company name masked]'s commercially accepted criteria.
cond_0552.responsibilities:
Providing quality leadership on shift
Performing microbiological testing of water, distilled products and ingredients.
Performing process audits to monitor compliance to Global Risk Management and [Location masked] Standards
Performing inspections of raw materials to ensure conformance to product specifications
Performing sensory analysis of in process products, finished products and ingredients
Performing analytical testing on in process products, finished products and ingredients to ensure adherence to product specifications
Outputs/Deliverables:
Development, implementation and maintenance of an asset care program for testing equipment that covers maintenance, calibration, repair and replacement.
Document procedures to ensure consistency in the use and operation of test equipment
Define the requirements and train Quality Technicians to perform basic troubleshooting of equipment.
Perform microbiological testing and analysis in accordance with Company defined protocols
cond_0552.requirements:

Some exposure to microbiological test methodology is a plus.
Some background working in a production laboratory that directly supports on site production and/or processing departments.
Some familiarity with non-conforming product hold management is a plus.
Ability to analyze issues and work through logical resolutions.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Good organization skills and ability to manage multiple tasks.
